item.arcanum_storage.end_pouch.tooltip: A portable door to your ender chest. Right-click to open.

item.arcanum_storage.end_pouch.bound: Arcanum Binding: consumed on death to seal your armor, hotbar and offhand in an Archive Cache inside your ender chest.

message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.st: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache inside your ender chest.
message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.ov: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache. Your ender chest was full, so the cache was placed in your inventory.
message.arcanum_storage.archive_cache.dr: Your Arcanum Binding sealed your equipment in an Archive Cache. There was no room, so it fell at your feet.

Craft Archive Cable and use it to link chests.
item.arcanum_storage.field_ledger.toolti: A practical manual that records what you have verified. Right-click to open.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.title: Field Ledger
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.subtitle: Practical manual and historical annals
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.unknown_hint: This page is still unknown. The missing references are listed here.
Gather a book, ink, copper and redstone. The Registry records what you have already learned.
You have a book. Ink, copper and redstone are still missing.
Craft the Field Ledger. Opening it recovers verifiable knowledge from your inventory, ender chest and statistics.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.storage_conne: Gather redstone blocks, repeaters and a comparator.
You have redstone. Repeaters and a comparator are still missing.
Craft the Storage Connector and place it beside a chest.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.storage_displ: You need gold, iron, a diamond and ender eyes.
You have gold. Iron, a diamond and ender eyes are still missing.
Craft the Storage Display and place it on top of the connector.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.archive_conne: A shulker shell is the first step.
You have the shell. Copper, redstone and a piston are still missing.
Craft the Archive Connector and use it with the press.

gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.end_pouch.par: You have the ender chest. Chorus fruit, a shell, eyes, leather and string are still missing.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.end_pouch.com: Craft the End Pouch and open it at least once.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.ender_display: The End Pouch must be unenchanted. You also need a Storage Display, Archive Cable, Storage Connector and an emerald block.
You have an End Pouch. The display, cable, connector and emerald block are still missing.
Craft the Ender Display and place it. It shows your ender chest and the contents of the shulker boxes inside it.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.anal.founding: The first Archivists wrote on whatever they had. The Registry was born from the need to remember what had already been proven.
Repeaters were replaced by Archive Cable. A single connector can reach twenty chests, and every chest keeps its own place.
The Binding was designed for the End Pouch. On death it seals armor, hotbar and offhand in a named cache inside the ender chest.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.anal.cache.bo: A placed cache vanishes when emptied and closed. The Archivists did not want empty names piling up after every death.
gui.arcanum_storage.ledger.anal.last_rec: When every page of the Manual is complete, the Registry closes with a single line: what was learned cannot be taken away.
